config.label: Error timeout
config.help: Timeout served after a wrong well or no response.

config.label: Correct-trial ITI
config.help: Intertrial interval after a correct response.

config.label: Hold-failure timeout
config.help: Timeout served when the rat pokes but fails to hold.

config.label: No-go withhold window
config.help: How long a response must be withheld on a no-go trial.

config.label: Odor priming delay
config.help: Odor is primed this long before the trial light comes on.

config.label: IR polling interval
config.help: How often the beam sensors are read. Lower is finer-grained and busier.

config.label: Failure-to-initiate penalty
config.help: Base timeout when the rat never pokes within the odor-port window.

config.label: Escalating lazy penalty
config.help: Grow the penalty with each consecutive abstention.

config.label: Escalation step
config.help: Added per consecutive abstention while escalation is on.

config.label: Escalation ceiling
config.help: Upper bound on the escalated penalty.

config.label: Escalation starts at stage
config.help: Escalation stays off until this stage is reached, so an animal still being eased in is never escalated against.

config.label: Reward — Go right
config.help: Solenoid open time when this condition is answered correctly -- its reward volume. Overrides the trial-table row for this run.

config.label: Reward — Go left
config.help: Solenoid open time when this condition is answered correctly -- its reward volume. Overrides the trial-table row for this run.

config.label: Session trial cap
config.help: The session ends after this many completed trials.

config.label: Left correction budget
config.help: Leading correction trials on LEFT-correct trials: an error repeats the same side until the budget is spent.

config.label: Right correction budget
config.help: Leading correction trials on RIGHT-correct trials: an error repeats the same side until the budget is spent.

config.label: Bias window
config.help: Sliding window of recent expressed choices the estimate is drawn from.

config.label: Max same-side run
config.help: Hard cap on consecutive identical correct sides.

config.label: Debias strength
config.help: How hard selection pushes against the rat's recent bias.

config.label: P(side) floor
config.help: Selection never goes fully deterministic, which would itself be a cue.

config.label: P(side) ceiling
config.help: Selection never goes fully deterministic, which would itself be a cue.

config.label: Odor poke hold
config.help: Hold required before odor delivery, and again while sampling.

config.label: Fluid well hold
config.help: Hold required at the correct well before reward.

config.label: Response window
config.help: Window to respond after successful odor sampling.

config.label: Odor port window
config.help: Window to poke the odor port after the trial light comes on.
